description_en: A heavily customized Steelbreaker, coated with a distinctive metal layer that combines aesthetic appeal with exceptional durability. [Self-Repair System]: When the vehicle's HP drops below 2000, it recovers 20 hp/s.
description_zh: 一架深度客制化的钢陨，其表面附加了一层某种金属，既美观又耐用。 [自修复系统]：载具血量低于2000时，每秒恢复20生命值。
